method.assistant_turn: Unique message.id across in-window non-sidechain assistant records; usage max per repeated response; missing transcript is null, never zero.
method.cohort: Run dispatched in window or promoted on primary branch in window; later promotions do not enter the denominator.
method.hand_commits: Not measured exhaustively: explicit successful worker-tree commit commands were searched, but quiet commits and copied diffs require a separate provenance join. Diagnostic zeros are not absence claims.
method.input_tokens: uncached + cache creation + cache read; logical input volume, not billed tokens or dollars
method.landed_node: Distinct run with in-window primary-branch promote commit, successful complete receipt, or promoted_revision already committed at cutoff; administrative promotions include failed and not-run outcomes, reported by gate and role.
method.merges: First-parent primary history at pinned cutoff, diff against first parent touching docs/plans or docs/evidence; git merge-tree on exact two parents. Any-path and docs-path conflicts separate; non-0/1 exits unmeasured.
method.promotion_refusal_reasons: Error lines as well as JSON refusals are parsed; exact reasons, source lines and per-refusal turns live in attempts artifact. Summaries group by emitted code and regex-labelled reason; cli-error denotes a CLI without a structured code. Clipped success markers are counted separately from full JSON.
method.retry_latency: Assistant responses after refusal result through next observed positive protocol receipt in the same operation family and session, not necessarily the same node. Same-batch successes are not assigned latency. Overlapping intervals are not additive active labor.
method.scope: Whole coordinator session activity inside window, including work not assigned to crew; no claim of causal time or monetary cost.
method.tool_mix: One exclusive category per tool_use ID; compound shell calls count once using ordered classifier; other is retained.
method.worker_streams: Not consumed; all recorded coordinator harnesses use message-style session transcripts. No absence claim about thread.started worker streams.
